'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Thornton LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I want the cupcake factory to BURN
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
